reviews.review: Pretty damn good, I wish you could hot swap attachments in the field though.
The Left4Dead review bombers are some of the most cringe people I've seen. Sorry you guys can't play as MLP characters and Shrek? Imagine giving a negative review because this game is MORE complex.
I love playing this with my friend, not really a single player game though.

TLDR; Totally worth trying for yourself, no regrets to date, challenging and refreshing to this experienced SOLO FPS player.

I love the new sounds of certain enemies, and the variety of weapons is very good. The feel and  sounds of the weapons matters a lot to me in what I play (as it should) and this game is top-notch in that area. The guns sound great, the attachments on them alter their sounds and sounds great. 
The gameplay is much like many FPS games so I'm not stuck floundering around trying to figure out how to play this one. The card system is awesome, I really like that they introduced a new, and strategic way to get buffed in the game, and the elements of random such as the cards and the upgrades keeps me from getting bored, it keeps me on my toes looking for better loot most of the game.  
The finales are for once not the same ol' ♥♥♥♥♥, which I appreciate. I'm not going to rate a difficulty because that obviously depends on the player and the difficulty chosen but I will say that there is a learning curve to getting better at this particular game, regardless of your experience level, which is refreshing. If I didn't want to try a new game with new things, I'd have stuck to my old games with their old things. 
Don't listen to the numbskulls comparing this to Left 4 Dead. This may have similarities, like how artists and companies have styles, but this is it's own thing and I am thoroughly glad I gave the game a chance and made a decision myself on whether or not I liked it, and I do very much. I also thoroughly enjoyed the new gross take on the undead/infected, again this was refreshing to me.
One caveat to my opinion however is that I only play solo.  Too many bad experiences in other online gaming with hackers, bots, QQers, fcking kids that won't shut fck up, pricks that endlessly fill up the messages with their B.S. and their clancrap, and vote-bans just cuz I aim for the head and have decent reflexes. The solo is totally worth it and for me it has been a fun adventure. The only downside to solo are that the bots are fcking dumb. They sidestep, jump and strafe constantly like CS:Source players do so they keep falling into the water and dying on certain maps, magically falling out of windows that are too shut to get through, lobbing 'nades at walls or my head, or making it dang near impossible to get a good clean sniper shot on an enemy (Down In Front card an absolute must) and I cannot let go of how stupid it is watching them snipe a wormy with their shotgun when they weren't even facing that direction, yet when I am taking point and getting mobbed, the bots are like fcking not watching my back. 
Cards which boost penetration make a real difference for a sharpshooter. I experienced true satisfaction as Jim when I fired a 50-cal through 3 enemies and then into an exploder, a one-shot wonder than was. Got a whole line of infected once too. These make for memorable occasions. And certain cards change the game just when you might start getting bored, like the card for holding two primary weapons, which rose the level of fun ten-fold when I was starting to get bored. The combo of potential perma-death on a run (but only the run, so only a loss of a few hours of my life) and actually intense bosses and finales actually gets my blood rushing, and only sometimes from frustration. The jumpscares are quite good as well, the sleepers still get me sometimes. 
The level of detail in the maps is fantastic, I like being able to judge cabinetmaking equipment in games and when they get it right or not (I am one) and although they didn't "nail" it here, they didn't "screw" it up either. This game has the best practice grounds I've ever seen, my jaw almost dropped looking at the tables. And last but certainly not least.. Tony Todd. They saved him for last and I loved it.
The combat is amazing, the scaling is also challenging yet annoying to deal with.
